text:
Maya: Evening team — quick coordination ask. I'm trialing a 2-week evening triage shadow overlap to smooth handoffs and speed initial prioritization. Looking for volunteers for a short overlap slot (proposed 17:00–17:30 local) and a separate 5–10m 'incident prioritization' micro-standup at the start of the next oncall shift. Reply here or react with :raised_hand: to sign up.

Jon: I can take the 17:00–17:30 slot Mon/Wed this week. Happy to chair the prioritization micro-standup on Tue.

Priya: @Maya I can do Wed morning prioritization (10m) and take Thursday evening overlap if you need. Can we include a checklist item to confirm rollbacks + prow job status in the start brief?

Alex: I'm +1 for trying a shorter overlap — 15m might be enough if we keep it focused. Sat night coverage: I can be backup if someone signs up for the slot.

Sasha: Suggest a tight agenda template for the micro-standup so it stays <10m: one-liner incident summary, impact (customers/infra), current owner, immediate mitigation, next steps. Example:
```
- INC-1234: model-server OOMs -> 20% query failures -> owner: Priya -> mitigation: scale pool to 8 -> follow-up: eviction tuning
```
Keep it bullet-y.

oncall-bot: Reminder: add rotation calendar event here: https://calendar.redwood/internal/eng-oncall (automated)

Maya: Love that template, Sasha — adding it to the runbook. Link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-triage (please ping if you can't access). I'll create two recurring events:
- "Evening overlap (shadow)" 17:00–17:15 (trial)
- "Oncall shift kickoff — prioritization" 10m at shift start

Maya: Proposed attendance: primary oncall (required), secondary oncall (optional but encouraged), oncall lead (rotating), SRE rep once per week. If an incident >sev2 is open, page the relevant service owner into the kickoff.

Jon: Can we include a quick check of active alerts + open deploys in the kickoff? 30s each with links to grafana/deploy.

Priya: yes — adding these to the template. Also can we set a Slack reminder 5m before each kickoff? saves people jumping in late.

Maya: done. I'll post the calendar invites after folks confirm. Current sign-ups: Jon (Mon/Wed overlap), Priya (Thu overlap, Wed kickoff), Alex (backup Sat). Still need night/weekend volunteers for this trial (2 weekend slots).

Alex: I'll take the backup oncall for Sun night if someone else takes Sat primary.

Sasha: tiny nit — can we call the micro-standup the 'triage sprint' in the calendar so it doesn't look like a full meeting? helps reduce no-shows.

Maya: Good idea, renaming event to 'Triage Sprint — 10m'. Final action items:
- Folks sign up in this thread or react :raised_hand:
- I will create calendar events and attach the agenda template + links
- Update runbook with template and escalation path

Jon: :thumbsup:
Priya: :thumbsup:
Alex: :thumbsup:
Sasha: :thumbsup:
Maya: Thanks everyone — I'll follow up with invites and the updated runbook changes shortly.
